Short answer

To install once on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add once-bin. It is a 5.2 MB download (13.6 MB installed), version 0.3.4-1, licensed MIT. CLI/TUI for installing and managing self-hosted web applications. Free and open source.

Install once on Omarchy

ONCE is a self-hosting platform from 37signals (Basecamp's parent company): a single Go binary that automates installing, updating, backing up, and monitoring Docker-based web applications on your own hardware, from a VPS down to a Raspberry Pi. It ships with 37signals' own apps ready to go but works with any Docker image that serves HTTP on port 80 and exposes a health-check endpoint, and it's driven through both a terminal dashboard and plain CLI commands.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add once-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.3.4-1:
    pacman -Qi once-bin

Open and use once

once has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql once-bin | grep /usr/bin/

once requirements and compatibility

  • A Docker-capable Linux or macOS machine to host apps on
  • Network access for pulling images, updates, and backups

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • docker

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: MIT.

Uninstall once

omarchy pkg drop once-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install once on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add once-bin. The download is 5.2 MB and it takes 13.6 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is once free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall once?

Run omarchy pkg drop once-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does once depend on?

The package declares 1 dependency: docker. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is once a desktop app?

No. once has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is once in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as once-bin (version 0.3.4-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. 37signals makes it. Project site: https://github.com/basecamp/once. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
